mapper.select: SELECT relation.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID, student.STUDENT_ID, student.NAME AS STUDENT_NAME, student.EMAIL, student.PHONE FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT relation JOIN TB_STUDENT student ON student.STUDENT_ID = relation.STUDENT_ID AND student.STATUS = 'Y' AND student.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE relation.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND relation.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND relation.STATUS = 'Y' AND relation.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT link.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID, location.LOCATION_ID, location.NAME AS LOCATION_NAME, location.ADDRESS FROM TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION link JOIN TB_LOCATION location ON location.LOCATION_ID = link.LOCATION_ID AND location.STATUS = 'Y' AND location.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE link.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = #{teacherStudentId} AND location.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND link.STATUS = 'Y' AND link.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY location.DISPLAY_ORDER, link.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID

SELECT enrollment.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID, enrollment.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID, curriculum.NAME AS CURRICULUM_NAME, enrollment.IS_REENROLLED, enrollment.MEMO FROM TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM enrollment JOIN TB_CURRICULUM curriculum ON curriculum.CURRICULUM_ID = enrollment.CURRICULUM_ID AND curriculum.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND curriculum.STATUS = 'Y' AND curriculum.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE enrollment.STATUS = 'Y' AND enrollment.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND enrollment.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID IN
#{teacherStudentLocationId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY curriculum.DISPLAY_ORDER, enrollment.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID

SELECT monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, monitoring.MONITORING_ID, content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID, content.NAME AS CONTENT_DETAIL_NAME, monitoring.DISPLAY_ORDER, content.TARGET_BPM, monitoring.CURRENT_BPM, monitoring.PROGRESS_STATUS, monitoring.MEMO FROM TB_STUDENT_MONITORING monitoring JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL content ON content.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = monitoring.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID AND content.STATUS = 'Y' AND content.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE monitoring.STATUS = 'Y' AND monitoring.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{studentCurriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY monitoring.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, monitoring.DISPLAY_ORDER, monitoring.MONITORING_ID

SELECT homework.MONITORING_ID, homework.HOMEWORK_ID, homework.HOMEWORK_CONTENT, homework.DEADLINE, homework.IS_COMPLETED, homework.FEEDBACK FROM TB_HOMEWORK homework WHERE homework.STATUS = 'Y' AND homework.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND homework.MONITORING_ID IN
#{monitoringId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY homework.CREATED_AT, homework.HOMEWORK_ID
